kettle.line: Your heart sings like a kettle
stanza: Your heart sings like a kettle
And your words, they boil away like steam

You are lonely as a church
Despite the queuing out your door
I am empty as a promise, no more

petal.line: And I was still a dewey petal
stanza: You made your major overtures
When you were a sure and orotund mutt
And I was still a dewey petal
Rather than a moribund slut
My love wrecked you
You packed to twirl your skirt at the palace
It hurt more than it ought to hurt
I went to work to cultivate a callus

settle.line: All the debts, they got settled
stanza: All the debts, they got settled
And the settlers got cattle
But the cattle was rattled by the snakes
